title: Tiny, cute guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='10' width='12' height='40' rx='4' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- Neck highlight -->
  <rect x='46' y='10' width='4' height='40' rx='2' fill='#E0A85C'/>
  <!-- Frets -->
  <rect x='44' y='18' width='12' height='2' fill='#F5E6C8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='26' width='12' height='2' fill='#F5E6C8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='34' width='12' height='2' fill='#F5E6C8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='2' fill='#F5E6C8'/>
  <!--Headstock-->
  <rect x='42' y='4' width='16' height='10' rx='4' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Body upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#E8A43C'/>
  <!-- Body lower bout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#E8A43C'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#F2BE5E'/>
  <!-- Sound hole -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='8' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='6' fill='#3A2210'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x='40' y='80' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='8' x2='47' y2='82' stroke='#FFF8E7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#FFF8E7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='8' x2='53' y2='82' stroke='#FFF8E7' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Cute face on body -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='72' r='2' fill='#3A2210'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='72' r='2' fill='#3A2210'/>
  <path d='M46 76 Q50 80 54 76' stroke='#3A2210' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FF8C94' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#FF8C94' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
